# Signing certificates (SHA-256) of published APKs that are no longer used.
# fusion.yml publishes an APK signed with another key than the published one
# only when the published one's certificate is listed here.
#
# Builds 1 to 13 were each signed with a different, throwaway debug key (the
# Android Gradle plugin's own, not the cached fallback key), so none of them
# can be updated in place; build 13's is retired here.
